title: The Legend of the Golden King
description: Hyper-realistic 12fps mythological storytelling for Wan 2.1/2.2 with audio-visual synchronization.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hyper-realistic mythological fantasy. A giant, glowing golden egg with intricate divine carvings cracking open in a deep obsidian cosmic void. Shards of golden shell fly toward the camera. Intense light spills out, taking the form of a massive bird silhouette. Swirling high-detail gold and deep purple nebulae.
scenes.motion_prompt: Fast dolly-in towards the central crack; high-speed radial particle expansion; 12fps flickering light pulses with volumetric depth.
scenes.narration: Long before the oceans were calmed, a power was born that shook the heavens.

scenes.visual_prompt: Character Anchor: Lord Garuda. Fierce white eagle face, metallic golden beak, glowing emerald eyes, muscular human torso. He wears a crown of sun-fire and living serpents coiled as jewelry. Massive copper wings with hyper-detailed shimmering feathers. Cinematic lighting, soft depth of field, realistic textures.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow vertical crane shot from talons to the eyes; rhythmic chest breathing; subtle secondary motion in the flowing hair and serpents.
scenes.narration: Half-man, half-eagle, his body glowed with the brilliance of a thousand suns.

scenes.visual_prompt: Same character: Lord Garuda soaring vertically at immense speed, carrying a massive stone mountain in his talons. Volumetric white clouds part physically around his body. The background earth is a distant green landscape. Cinematic wide shot, high-contrast lighting, realistic fluid-like cloud displacement.
scenes.motion_prompt: Dynamic tracking shot from behind; camera vibration on wing beats; parallax effect with ground receding; volumetric cloud trails.
scenes.narration: He flew higher than any god dared, driven by a sacred vow to free his mother.

scenes.visual_prompt: Same character: Lord Garuda in a deep respectful bow. Before him, a radiant blue silhouette of Lord Vishnu. A massive, rotating golden mandala wheel in the background. Ethereal god rays piercing through the scene. High-fidelity cosmic atmosphere, divine particles.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow 360-degree orbital rotation; background mandala wheel spinning; floating divine embers; slow zoom-out revealing the cosmic scale.
scenes.narration: Today, he is the king of birds, reminding us that with purpose, you become unstoppable.
